beats.summary: Dwight proposes an impractical get-well gift for Deangelo, which is rejected in favor of traditional baskets.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: No, you can't get flowers for someone who's in a coma. They'll wilt before he wakes up.
Jim: All in favor of the baskets full of chocolates, teddy bears, and balloons?

beats.summary: Dwight accepts the acting manager position, surprising Jim and Pam.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (on phone): Dwight Schrute. Yes, I would.

beats.summary: Dwight implements strict managerial changes including time clocks, new business cards, and staggered lunch breaks.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Dwight has been acting manager for three months now. No. A week. Just feels like three months.

beats.summary: Dwight confronts Kelly about being late, invading her privacy with a medical joke.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: It's none of your business, actually. It's very medical and personal.

beats.summary: Gabe confesses his feelings for Erin to Andy and asks about their relationship status.

evidence.snippet: Gabe: Are you still in love with Erin?

beats.summary: Jim starts a social club called The Fist, which Dwight wants to join despite suspicion of rebellion.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Oh, it's just a social club.
Dwight: Okay, you know what? I would love to join The Fist.

notable_quotes.quote: I will never be happier than I am right now. I will also never be less happy.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I will never be happier than I am right now. I will also never be less happy.

notable_quotes.quote: People just come in and do their work on their schedule. Imagine that – people like us allowed to sell paper. Unsupervised.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jim

evidence.snippet: Jim: So as it turns out, unless you're a young child or a prison inmate, you don't need anyone supervising you.

notable_quotes.quote: Your copier code is a distinct 21-digit number that is unique to you, and you only, okay? Don't share it.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Your copier code is a distinct 21-digit number that is unique to you, and you only, okay? Don't share it.

notable_quotes.quote: I don't want to mess this up, right? There's a consensus, people are happy.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jim

evidence.snippet: I don't want to mess this up, right? There's a consensus, people are happy.
